scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@second-brain/shared && npm run build --workspace=@second-brain/web
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace=@second-brain/shared && npm run lint --workspace=@second-brain/shared && npm run lint --workspace=@second-brain/web && python3 -m compileall -q apps/api/src apps/worker/src packages/agent/src packages/rag/src packages/memory/src packages/graph/src packages/mcp/src
scripts.test: npm run check:contracts && npm run test --workspace=@second-brain/shared && python3 scripts/check_python_packages.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s apps/api/tests -p 'test_*.py'
